gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Redux spreads its wide-set letters across the line, each curve taking a big visible run-in. Noto Sans Tangsa follows as a plain sans with short ascender stems, so a long passage moves along without any fuss.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC has large open counters and curves that flare outward rather than curling in. Redux, with its medium-low stroke contrast, adds a geometric display voice above, while the sans underneath keeps things approachable.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Wide-spaced and geometric, with a slight living wobble in every stroke from Redux up top. Noto Sans Telugu, a plain sans with a high-set midline, carries a long passage along quietly.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-thai: Spacious, round and a bit playful, this pair starts with Redux. Its understated thick-thin shifts sit above Noto Sans Thai, whose swollen lowercase, like inflated glass beads, gives the sans a puffy friendliness beneath.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-thai-loope: Clean lines run through both fonts, though Redux stretches its geometric letters wide with a big entrance into each curve. And Noto Sans Thai Looped answers in tall, bold-looking lowercase with spacious gaps at its terminals, a sans-serif that feels sturdier than the heading above.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Wide, geometric and softly swelling, that's Redux up top. Noto Sans Tifinagh fills the line below with inflated-looking bowls, and its rounded sans-serif letters stay open, so heading and body feel like one friendly family.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-vai: Redux makes each curve swell gently, with wide spacing and a big entrance stroke. Noto Sans Vai builds words into solid blocks rather than skylines, so a longer stretch of this sans reads smooth and steady.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Modern and tidy, both of them. Redux gives stems a touch more thickness than its connecting strokes, while Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps open throats and a minimal step from capitals to lowercase, a sans-serif that lets the heading lead.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Chunky, chalky and wide, with real presence. Noto Sans Wancho brings a hulking lowercase and an e with a gaping terminal, while Redux above it stays lighter, a gentle weight change where each bowl curves around.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-warang-cit: Redux has a lightly flexed spring wire's tempered contrast, with wide spacing and a big entrance into every curve. Noto Sans Warang Citi, a sans, shapes words into solid blocks.
